chunks.content: During March 2025, Manufacturing Cell A operated under nominal conditions throughout the entire planned production period. No unscheduled stoppages were recorded. All preventive maintenance activities were carried out according to plan PM-2025-Q1. The Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) reached 95.1%, exceeding the company target of 93%. A total of 18,740 components were produced and inspected, with a first-pass yield of 99.7%.
